rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-27 SCALE iter-25 CHAMPION (hr 0.2930 @1925p): the single zero-init-gain image bilateral that TRAINED NON-ZERO -> +0.041 hr. PRIOR: iter-7 FoE-only 0.2515 ceiling; iter-25 +1 parallel bilateral @sigma(1.5,1.5) NEW CHAMPION 0.2930. FAILURE MODE: iter-25 single-scale RF cannot both preserve fine edges AND smooth broad noise; campaign multi-scale via POOLING (microunet 2/5/6) REGRESSED (psnr cap 32.4). CHANGE (ONE knob): scale bilateral branch M=1->M=3 MULTI-RF PARALLEL BANK reg(x)=FoE(x)+Sum_i gain_i*(x-BF_i(x)), distinct spatial sigma {0.8,1.6,3.2}px (octave ladder small/mid/large), each PER-FILTER zero-init gain. NO pooling. PARAMS: FoE 1920 + alpha 1 + 3*(3 sigma + 1 gain)=12 = 1933 (iter-7 1921, iter-25 1925; +8 over iter-25). VERIFIED LOCAL: 1933p, 3 zero-init gains, bank==0 at init regardless of sigma, FoE(x)==0 (zero-init RBF) => reg==iter-7 byte-for-byte. KEEP iter-25/7: FoE nf24/k7/nb31 zero-init RBF, K=5 tied prox+DC, single scalar alpha, no momentum/per-step-alpha, peak lr 5e-3, partial cosine T_max=16, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, val_n=214, per-sample-ps, grad_clip, full-view DC. HYPOTHESIS: multiple spatial scales add MORE headroom than iter-25 single bilateral -> hr>0.2930; NULL (one gain non-zero, hr~0.2930)=one scale suffices. SAFE: zero-init gains => worst case ~iter-25/iter-7. PREDICTED hr ~0.293-0.31.
